quest.title: A Saurian Lover's Ordinary Days
quest.description: You encounter someone surrounded by three Saurians out in the wild...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000, Recipe: Sour Sauce Ceviche x1

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.text: My dear, your enthusiasm is... quite overwhelming. Phew... Shall we have some ice to cool our heads, then talk about this later?

dialogues.speaker: Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Shrawrr—!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You hear a scream at first, followed by the thud of something heavy falling to the ground. Then, all that's left are Saurian cries...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? Is that person alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, he's surrounded... We can't see what's going on at all...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shall we try a view from above?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm. Seems like {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} wants to give it a try — go on then, little buddy!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Grawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, something's not right. Is that person dead— Ugh, no, no, pish posh! Maybe he just passed out. But still, we can't just stand by and do nothing!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, could you three please let us through?

dialogues.speaker: Tepetlisaurus
dialogues.text: Shrar! Grawr!

dialogues.speaker: Koholasaurus
dialogues.text: Mmrawr...?

dialogues.speaker: Yumkasaurus
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, they won't let us through at all... What's going on? Considering what that person said before, he might know these Saurians...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If only we had more clues...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: ...Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm? Have you discovered something, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}? Come on, let's keep up!

talks.objective: Find a way to distract the Saurians together with your Saurian companion

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Today's a rainy day. I prepared "Ripple" his favorite <color=#00E1FFFF>Sour Sauce Ceviche</color>. His look of satisfaction made it all worthwhile..."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Even if he's swimming in a leisurely manner, the moment I proffer some of that <color=#00E1FFFF>Sour Sauce Ceviche</color>... Whoosh! Out he pops from the water, and in such lovely form, too..."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Diary
dialogues.text: "...I would never doubt his affection for me. Only, perhaps, that he might love <color=#00E1FFFF>the ceviche</color> more..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So... Ripple's this Koholasaur's name, huh? Guess the Sour Sauce Ceviche in the pot must've been for him.

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Big round sparkling eyes, curly tail and cheery cries... Jade, oh, Jade, is there a cuter Saurian in this world than you...?"

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Diary
dialogues.text: "...You have never once been cheated, nor never once doubted, as if all life might become your friend and enjoy a wonderful time playing with you..."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Were I not so busy, I'd love to play with you all day, watching you dart through woods swimming in mottled sunlight, like a child of the wind, a spirit oh so carefree..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Ah, so that little Yumkasaur is named "Jade." Playful, too, sounds like. Maybe you two could be friends, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Diary
dialogues.text: "...I've crossed mountains and valleys just to search for your whereabouts. If you truly wished not to see me, you could have departed..."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Diary
dialogues.text: "...But you had consideration for my pace, stopping every so often, even collecting so much Grainfruit on my behalf, not to mention those shiny stones..."

dialogues.speaker: Someone's Diary
dialogues.text: "...Oh Marigold, my lovely Marigold, only I know the tender heart that lies beneath your hard shell. To be a fighter so fierce was never your intent..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Err, so Marigold's that grumpy Tepetlisaurus, then? Call Paimon blind, but she sure doesn't see how that one counts as "tender"!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, back on topic. So these three Saurians are... his friends? Why'd they knock him unconscious and surround him, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's get him out first and ask questions later.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's true. If only we could get them to make way... Hang on, didn't the diary say that Ripple fancies Sour Sauce Ceviche? There's some in camp, so maybe we can use it as a lure!

choices.text: #As for Jade... Let's send {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to go make a friend, shall we?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Great idea! Jade's the fun-loving sort, so {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} just needs to lead 'er off somewhere.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #See, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s excited about the plan too! But perhaps the simplest and least wasteful way would be to use the Sour Sauce Ceviche, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Err, let's resolve this by more peaceful means, shall we? Like getting {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} to lure the fun-loving Jade away...

talks.objective: Bring the Sour Sauce Ceviche from the camp
Place the Sour Sauce Ceviche in a suitable location

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, looks like he was attracted by the scent of the food.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #The gap's not large enough, though. Could you help us lure Jade away, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nice! We'll leave it to you, then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Let's go check on the guy and see if he's okay once {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} leads Jade off, alright?

talks.objective: Wait for your Saurian buddy to lure the Yumkasaurus away

dialogues.speaker: "Marigold"
dialogues.text: Shrawrr—!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't get so worked up, we're just checking to see if the guy over there's unhurt.

choices.text: Seems like it's time to duel.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, don't give up that quickly! Look, we don't mean any harm, and we... Well, we're sure that you're not the fighty type by nature...

response.speaker: "Marigold"
response.text: Shrar! Grawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh oh... She's getting even angrier!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There's a diary over here...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After being defeated, the Tepetlisaurus named "Marigold" drills into the ground and hides only who-knows-where. You take the chance to check on the injured person...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No obvious wounds... Hey, are you alright? Can you hear Paimon?
...Hmm? Marigold? Ah, you gentle soul. You're concerned about me, aren't you? Worry not. I've been training myself to play with you without any worries...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hey, Paimon's Paimon, y'hear? Not some Marigold! {NICKNAME}, do you think he might have hurt his head in the fall?

choices.text: With any luck, his head will clear up soon.

response.text: Wait. You're not Marigold. What's going on? What happened to me?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell him of how he was surrounded by the three Saurians and knocked down by Marigold...

response.speaker: Icayo
response.text: Ah, so that's what happened. Sorry for the trouble. The name's Icayo. As you can see, I'm an adventurer who loves chasing Saurians... and who sometimes winds up being chased by them.

response.speaker: Icayo
response.text: I had a spell of ill-health that resulted in my being bedridden for a while. Not only did my stamina decline greatly during that time, but I wasn't able to meet them on the regular either...

response.speaker: Icayo
response.text: To have been surrounded by them even before making it to camp... Ah, how fortunate I am, to be one so fretted over.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, we had a bit of a... tussle with Marigold in our rush to save you...

response.speaker: Icayo
response.text: Ah, nothing to worry about. I imagine that was no different from any other game to her. She's probably off sulking somewhere over the loss.

response.speaker: Icayo
response.text: Despite appearances, she's got a delicate soul. I'll go comfort her later, so again, don't you worry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then. Looks like you're fine. Guess we worried for nothing, but Paimon's glad you're okay all the same.

response.speaker: Icayo
response.text: And I'm grateful for that. Ah, yes. While this isn't of much value... Please, take this Sour Sauce Ceviche recipe of mine, would you?

response.speaker: Icayo
response.text: #Ripple loves this dish — maybe your companion, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, might too!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Roooah... Rawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hmm? Wanna give it a try, eh? No need to worry, {NICKNAME} will make some for you!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You cannot get closer due to Saurian obstruction...
